Seasonal Department Fixed Term Team Member

Buildmart needs no introduction as a proudly New Zealand owned and operated business – you see us in almost every town in NZ.  Buildmart MEGA Cambridge, as part of Buildmart (New Zealand) Ltd, is a dynamic and growing company, with a vision to provide great quality products, value, customer service and expertise to enable our customers to have an affordable and easy DIY experience.

 

Here at Buildmart Mega Cambridge, we are looking to fill a FIXED TERM, FULL-TIME role in our Seasonal Department, offering our customers service with outdoor furniture, BBQs and outdoor heating over Summer. 

This role reports to the department Team Leader and is a fixed term (Till the end of January 2027) 40-hour role on a Tuesday to Saturday roster. 

This role has the ability to be extended at the conclusion of the fixed term basis.

What we are looking for:

- A passion for customer service
- A can-do attitude
- Ability to problem solve
- Attention to detail
- Process and Procedure driven
- Previous big box retail experience would be a bonus
- A drive to learn and grow your career
- A love for working in a team environment
- Flexibility/Adaptability
-Ability to work as part of a team and independently
-Embrace and portray our core business values
-Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment

 

If this sounds like the position for you, apply below!
